items.title: 14.9.1 Bare air pollutants aur un ke sehat par asrat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.9.1, printed page 315.

blocks.text: Particulate matter hawa mein muallaq nanhe zarraat par mushtamil hai, jin mein dhool, mitti, kajal aur dhuan shamil hain, 2.5 micrometres se 10 micrometres qutr tak; ise saans mein lena saans ki naliyon mein jalan aur soojan karta hai, asthma aur bronchitis jaisi halaton ki taraf le jata hua. Nitrogen dioxide aur sulfur dioxide ka thori der ka samna saans ke nizam ko jalata hai, jabke lambe arse ka samna saans ki infection, asthma aur bronchitis ka khatra barhata hai.

blocks.caption: Pollutants aur sehat
rows: saans ki naliyon ki soojan aur jalan

blocks.prompt: Hawa ke mayar aur sehat par particulate matter ka asar wazeh karein (Quick Check 14.4a).
blocks.explanation: Muallaq zarraat hawa ko dhundla aur AQI ko ooncha karte hain; saans mein lene par mote zarraat naak aur gala jalate hain aur bareek PM2.5 phephron ki gehrai tak pohnch kar naliyon mein soojan aur asthma aur bronchitis karta hai, aur saalon mein dil ki bimari aur phephron ka cancer.

items: PM (2.5-10 micrometres) saans ki naliyan sujata hai: asthma, bronchitis. NO2 aur SO2: thori der mein jalan; lambi muddat mein infections, asthma, bronchitis.
